body: New GET /heightmap?scene=N&cx=X&cz=Z in server/worldapi returns per-column height + biome for Meadow (flat 4), Hills (real per-column variation via hillsColumnHeight, split out of hillsChunk so it can't drift from block generation), and Swampville (flat, water one block higher than land). Caves correctly returns 204 -- genuinely 3D, no single height per column. New tests cross-check the heightmap directly against hillsChunk's own real block output as a drift guard. Live-verified against the running gfd-server-go.service: Meadow uniform {4}, Hills min=2/max=8, Swamp {1,2}, Caves 204. go vet/go test ./... clean. Updated SMOOTH_TERRAIN_NORTHSTAR.md Milestone 1 to DONE. GoblinFoxDragon f9b4f14.
title: SMOOTH_TERRAIN Milestone 1: backend heightmap endpoint shipped
